content.text: Minimisere is an original trick-taking card game designed by David Parlett. It is a game of 'controlled winning and losing', where the objective is to win a specific number of tricks (e.g., three or four)â€”or none at allâ€”but avoiding the middle ground and, crucially, avoiding winning everything. It is a tactical game that rewards precise hand evaluation and the ability to 'dump' high cards into other players' tricks.
Designed by the renowned card game historian David Parlett in the late 20th century as a study in 'Inverted Bidding' and 'Misere' mechanics.
25 cards (Ace to 10, plus a 2 in each suit, and one Joker).
